### ui_notice

**Show notice**

Show a transient notice/toast in Obsidian.

#### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string (1–1000) | yes | Notice text. |
| `duration` | number (0–60000) | no | Milliseconds until the notice auto-dismisses (0 = sticky). |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `shown` | boolean | Always true once the notice was shown. |
